notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rav Shmuel bar Bidrei speaking in Rav’s name about when to recite the blessing over tefillin. The passage also gives two alternate attributions. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3382&lang=en) cites the same passage and lists the alternative names.
